profile.headline: Software Engineer at Jefferson County Public Schools
profile.summary:
I am a Senior Full Stack Developer with a "growth mindset" and a track record of transforming legacy technical debt into scalable, high-performance architecture. Having navigated high-stakes startup cultures—including SkuVault, PAI, and PSST—I specialize in "wearing many hats" to bridge the gap between DevOps, Architecture, and Project Management.

My expertise lies in modernizing monolithic systems. Whether re-architecting legacy VB.NET into C#, migrating to RESTful Web APIs, or optimizing SQL for multi-million dollar reporting, I focus on delivering seamless user experiences and robust back-end logic.

Technical Toolkit:

Back-End: .NET Core, C#, MVC, WebAPI, WPF, Entity Framework, Dapper

Database: SQL Server (Performance Tuning, Schema Design, Cursors/Functions)

Patterns: SOLID, DRY, KISS, Asynchronous Programming (Async/Await)

SDLC: End-to-end ownership from requirement gathering to deployment.

Experience Highlights

Integration Engineer / Software Developer | PSST, LLC

Legacy Modernization: Spearheaded the migration of monolithic applications to a modern Web API architecture and led a comprehensive VB.NET to C# logic rewrite.

API Optimization: Re-engineered synchronous data-access into Asynchronous patterns, eliminating thread-blocking and significantly increasing concurrent client throughput.

Enterprise Integrations: Developed mission-critical RESTful APIs linking proprietary client systems with 3rd-party HR/Payroll providers, ensuring 100% data integrity.

Software Engineer | Mortenson Family Dental

UI/UX Optimization: Transformed large-scale C# WPF applications using Async/Await, eliminating GUI freezes and providing real-time user feedback.

Full-Stack Ownership: Managed the complete SDLC for internal projects, including database design, system patterns, and DevOps-driven deployment.

Software Engineer | Payment Alliance International

Data Engineering: Optimized month-end financial reporting and imports utilizing advanced SQL Functions and Cursors.

Architectural Analysis: Applied SOLID principles to evaluate and implement data-access strategies comparing Entity Framework and Dapper.

positions.title: Integration Engineer / Software Developer
positions.description:
My favorite task was to maintain a large product written for .NET Framework. I reworked the code from VB.Net to C#.Net Core using SOLID and interfaces. Took those class libraries and maintain nugget packages, and contributed to optimizing the sql queries. 

I maintain WebAPI sync from FMS to 3rd party web application. Rework logging and business logic to keep up with client's needs.

I maintain windows applications with code updates and queries. Troubleshoot business logic in queries to return the correct data.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Using C# MVC .NET Core, SQL and Javascript ES6, Jquery to create visual charts to influence the organization's behavior of make decisions and create training to improve the quality of service.

WPF, .NET Core, SQL, WinForm, Console Applications to unstructured data into structured data. Writing Unit Test using NUnit.

Worked on maintenance of legacy projects in .Net 4.5 - 4.7. Stored Procedures and Functions in SQL 2016.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop applications and websites using solid pattern, factory, and reflections in a RAD development cycle with C# ASPX.

Maintain a product of PAI called Express. Which deals with new merchant registration form entry and screen scraping technique to store the formdata in xml and uses a mapping file to generate a downloadable pdf for sales rep and submit the xml with the formdata in SQL.

Process XML using Xpath to generate file for back-end batch file interface with sftp.
This is an extraction of data in a format that our bank processors understand according to the schema they provided.

SQL Skills Include: CRUD, Stored Procedure, Functions, Triggers, Outer/Inner Joins, Outer/Inner Apply, handling aggregates.
Troubleshoot problems of missing data. Created reports for Monthly, Weekly, Daily Application submission and reports.

Created scheduled tasks in Integration Manager
Run stored procedures nightly to update merchant statuses.

Creating responsive and interactive webforms using aspx with DOJO Javascript and ajax for Reporting, Information lookup, and new Merchant creation.

Create webpages with popups, javascript error checking, grids,  and drop downs.

Develop with 3rd party tools for server side schedule tasks such as email subscription with attachments, image conversion and resize, and PDF generation, and zip compression.

projects.title: Balance Score Card
projects.description:
This project was designed to show reports on company's ability to performance under budget and their collection of income. I was hired on board at the end of the project to finalize and fix the designs of the reports to the demands of the leaders they are building it for. I work with a project manager in a week sprint, and add 1 new report each week for 8 weeks.  

I was responsible for creating the grid, designing the charts, and manipulating the data to show the sum and average where needed. The chart designing did present a problem, such is when trying to represent the legend, changing the data column's colors, creating pivots, and marking the average line in the graph. But, I was confident I could do it since I had experience working with Collections in C#, and SQL. 

In the end, I learn how to apply my past knowledge to this project. Creating a report and maintaining this project became easier because I have written a generic helper class for the grid, and the chart. The balance scored card now is completed. Every now and then, I have to change name of the columns. But, it is very usable.
